            Solution lifecycle
            
          
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            Lifecycle status
            
          
            Read-only aggregate lifecycle counts for solutions explicitly originated at or linked to the granted location. Names, row IDs, narratives, evidence, funding amounts, and identities are omitted. Counts do not approve gates, release funding, or activate adoption.
            
          
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            Linked solutions
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
            
            Record a location discovery
            
            
            Requires an exact location create grant. This records a discovered solution at this location, with an attributed opening event. It does not create cross-location links or stage gates. Retrying unchanged values reuses the same request ID.
            
            
            
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
            
            
            
          
            
          
            Location-linked stage gates
            
          
            Gate definitions, thresholds, and evaluation status are scoped to the location. A location create grant can add an immutable draft promotion gate and append an evaluation; a different active human must approve a passing evaluation before transition. Criteria are visible to authorized readers and reviewers for that location. Keep participant identities and sensitive raw evidence out of criteria.
            
          
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
          
          
            
            
            Create a promotion-gate draft
            
            
            Requires exact location read and create grants. This creates one immutable promotion-gate definition in draft state, with a criterion and measurable thresholds for the current supported promotion. Evaluation and independent human approval are separate. It does not change the solution stage. Criteria are shared with authorized readers and reviewers for this location.
            
            
            
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
            
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
            
            Other lifecycle stage transitions
            
            
            Requires exact location read and transition grants. This panel handles non-promotion stages only. Validated, funded, adoption-ready, and scaled stages still require their approved stage-gate workflow; retirement uses its separate sunset process. Each transition records the expected current stage, a rationale, evidence, an optional rollback plan, human acknowledgement, and an immutable retry receipt. Moving to adopting also requires approved location readiness and configuration.
            
            
            
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
            
            Draft an experiment protocol
            
            
            Requires exact location read and create grants. This writes an immutable protocol draft for an active location-origin solution in experiment-ready or testing. Submission, consent review, protocol approval, observations, execution, and results review remain separate steps.
            
            
            
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
            
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
            Sequential analysis reads its direction and thresholds from this approved protocol. Add a benefit_direction_by_metric map for every declared key, using only higher or lower; optional benefit_threshold, posterior_threshold, and safety_event_limit are fixed when the protocol is approved.
            
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
            Declare consent explicitly. Participant protocols use {"participant_consent_required":true,"purpose":"...","consent_version":"v1"}. Non-personal measurements must use {"participant_consent_required":false,"non_personal_basis":"environmental_measurement"} (or the approved operational/infrastructure code). Missing or unrecognized policy is rejected.
            
              
              
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
            
            
          
            
          
            Experiments and reviewed outcomes
            
          
            This read shows experiment lifecycle metadata and only an explicitly reviewed outcome. Protocol narratives, metric names and values, observations, adverse-event details, and evidence remain private; this panel cannot approve or review results.
            
          
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
          
          
            Funding and tranche status
            
          
            This view contains lifecycle labels and timestamps only. Funding amounts, milestone terms, rationale, evidence, and submitter/approver/releaser identities remain private; no approval or release action is available.
            
          
            
            
            Create a funding draft
            
            
            Requires exact location read and create grants. This creates a private draft and optional proposed tranches only; it does not submit, approve, release funds, or advance the solution stage.
            
            
            
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
            
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Submit this draft for review
            
              
            This submits the draft for independent review. Submission does not approve the request, approve a tranche, release funds, or advance the solution stage.
            
              
            
                
                
                
            
              
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
          
          
            Additional lifecycle status
            
          
            Choose a location-scoped status projection. Each view uses the existing read grant and omits evidence, narrative, and person-level details described in the lifecycle contract. Adoption event summaries show only coarse consent-checked phase counts and withhold the whole breakdown when any phase has fewer than five distinct references.
            
          
            
            
            Adoption preparation and readiness
            
            
            Preparation requires an exact location create grant; readiness review requires an exact location review grant. Assessment and review are separate records, and only an independent review of the current assessment can mark readiness ready.
            
            
            
              
            Propose an adoption-program draft
            
              
            Requires exact location read and create grants. Active, location-origin solutions at pilot-active, adoption-ready, or adopting can be selected so an enablement program can be prepared before the adoption-ready gate. Every draft includes an immutable participant-consent purpose and version that an independent reviewer sees before approval.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
            The system records this under the fixed data category “solution_adoption_participation” and exact location scope. Consent must also be granted separately through the participant-consent process.
            
                
                
                
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Revise a program after a redesign decision
            
              
            A reviewed redesign remains unchanged. Create one linked draft revision with a replacement pathway. The new draft must be submitted and independently reviewed; it does not change readiness, configuration, participant consent, or launch state.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Submit your adoption-program drafts
            
              
            Only the human who created an exact-location draft can submit it. Submission starts independent community review of the pathway and its immutable participant-consent policy; it does not assess readiness, grant participant consent, or launch adoption.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Review submitted adoption programs
            
              
            Reviewers cannot review their own proposals. Review the fixed data category, purpose, and version alongside the pathway. An enablement-ready decision only approves this program proposal; each participant must still grant consent, and the decision does not launch adoption.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Propose a location configuration
            
              
            Choose an active solution originating at this location in pilot-active or adoption-ready stage. Configuration proposals are versioned drafts. Submit them for review separately; a different active human must approve or reject them. Approval does not start adoption.
            
              
            
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            My configuration drafts
            
              
            Only your unsubmitted drafts for this location appear here. Submission freezes the version and sends it to the independent review queue.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Review location configurations
            
              
            The queue excludes your own proposals. Review every component and the evidence impact, then record an independent approval or rejection with a reason. Rejection requires a new version.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Submit a location readiness assessment
            
              
            This records a human assessment and leaves readiness pending until a different active operator reviews it. A new assessment expires the prior ready state for this location and solution.
            
              
            
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
            
              
            
            
            
            
            
              
            Review readiness assessments
            
              
            The queue excludes your own assessments. Mark ready only when the submitted level meets the required level; otherwise request remediation or reject with a reason.
            
              
            
                
                
              
            
              
            
              
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
          
            
          
          
            
          
            
            
            Assess a scale gate
            
            
            Requires an exact location create grant. Typed measurements are evaluated against the configured comparator in PostgreSQL; untyped gates require a proposed result. Every assessment needs evidence and remains pending until a different active human reviews it. Gate approval does not change the solution stage.
            
            
            
              
              
            
            
            
            
            
            
          
            
          
            
            
            Independent scale-gate review
            
            
            Requires an exact location review grant and a different active human from the evaluator. Accepting the assessment updates only the current scale-gate result; rejecting it preserves the existing gate status. Neither decision advances the solution stage.

            Requires an exact location review grant and an active human reviewer independent from the report author, replication starter, initial approver, and source reviewers. Accepting a report completes the replication and records its reviewed outcome; the solution stage remains unchanged. Rejecting leaves the replication active so its operator may submit a revised report.

            Retirement review inbox
            
            
            Requires the exact location review grant and an active human identity binding. Proposal details may contain private evidence; they are shown as text, never as clickable links. Approval changes the proposal to approved but does not schedule or execute a retirement. The later migration, sunset, and post-retirement review steps are separately acknowledged. Sunset changes the solution to retired but deletes no data; retention and legal holds follow separately configured policy. Self-authored and unattributed proposals cannot be approved.

Registered generation coverage is indicative.
